rows.title_full:
ACCEPTANCE SPEECH OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez thanked the President for having espoused the message of unity and for supporting the leadership and legislative agenda of the House of Representatives.  He asked the Members for their unequivocal support to the leadership of the 19th Congress and he urged them to accept the duty to serve the people
Speaker Romualdez ensured the passage of measures that the people need and support development across all sectors of society and different levels of government, and promised to be fair and equitable in the distribution of resources for the development of the regions regardless of political affiliations
rows.title_short: Acceptance Speech Of Speaker Romualdez ( F. M.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2022-07-25

rows.title_full:
ACCEPTANCE SPEECH OF MINORITY LEADER LIBANAN 
Minority Leader Libanan thanked the members of the Majority and Minority for his orderly election and for the opportunity they had given him; and assured the Body that the Minority will perform their task responsibly.
rows.title_short: Acceptance Speech Of Minority Leader Libanan
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2022-07-26

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ
Speaker Romualdez recognized the immediate and collective action of the Members in passing bills and resolutions, including priority bills that aim to resuscitate the pandemic-batterred economy and make economic transformation the main engine to uplift the lives of the Filipino people. 
Speaker Romualdez highlighted the historic adoption of HCR No. 2 which expressed the collective support and commitment of the House to the 2022-2028 Medium-Term Fiscal Framework.  He underscored the detailed scrutiny of the Minority bloc and the tireless cooperation of the Executive department for the immediate approval on Third Reading of HB No. 4488 or the proposed â‚±5.268 trillion national spending plan for 2023.
Speaker Romualdez also said that the recent visit of the US President has made a solid and strong investment pitch to the American business community of the commitment of the Philippine House of Representatives to enact laws that would deepen the cooperation between the two countries, particularly in the areas of the supply chain, health and security, environment and climate change, energy security, and interconnectivity.
rows.title_short: Address Of Speaker Romualdez
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2022-09-28

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ 
Speaker Romualdez underscored the gains of the 19th Congress which followed a legislative program aligned with the priority measures that aims to institute public policies geared to fully revitalize the country´s pandemic-ravaged economy through job creation, equal economic opportunities for all, and ensure food on the table of every Filipino family. 
The Speaker added that the House of Representatives had passed several priority measures that were designed to alleviate poverty, sustain economic progress, and harness competencies in government for it to be able to deliver the highest degree of service to the Filipino people.
rows.title_short: Address Of Speaker Romualdez
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2022-12-15

rows.author: I059;
rows.title_full:
OPENING REMARKS OF REPRESENTATIVE ROMUALDEZ (Y.M.) 
Rep. Romualdez expressed honor as she and her fellow women legislators presided over the day´s session in celebration of National Women´s Month.  She spoke of women as powerful agents of change from being able to lead nations and influence economies to becoming trailblazers in their own fields.
rows.title_short: Opening Remarks Of Representative Romualdez ( Y. M.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2023-03-13

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
MESSAGE OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez commended the Members for their commitment and untiring efforts that led to the approval of 23 of the 31 vital measures identified by the LEDAC as priority measures that would further stimulate economic activities, create job opportunities, reduce poverty, and provide better health care and services to the Filipino people.
In acknowledging the significance of e-governance in the efficient delivery of public goods and services, Speaker Romualdez stated that the House, in partnership with the Senate recently launched the electronic Congress portal or “E-Congress”.
He also mentioned the action taken by the Committee on Ethics and Privileges against Rep. Arnolfo “Arnie” A. Teves Jr., which he said was an equally pressing matter that warranted the House´s urgent and sound response.
rows.title_short: Message Of Speaker Romualdez ( F. M.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2023-03-22

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
MESSAGE OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez first welcomed the Members back to the remainder of the First Regular Session of the 19th Congress.  He then relayed to the Body that he accompanied President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. to his trip to the United States for meetings with President Joseph R. Biden Jr., Vice President Kamala D. Harris, Defense Secretary Lloyd James Austin III, and high-ranking executives of the Central Intelligence Agency. He described the trip as most productive and successful where, in conjunction with the Executive, the Legislature had helped in furthering and enhancing the relationship between the Philippines and U.S.
rows.title_short: Message Of Speaker Romualdez ( F. M.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2023-05-08

rows.author: C069;
rows.title_full:
SPEECH OF MINORITY LEADER LIBANAN 
Minority Leader Libanan expressed his deep appreciation and gratitude to the Body for finishing the First Regular Session of the 19th Congress with remarkable achievements.  He said that despite their differences in opinions and beliefs, they have found creative solutions to address the issues at hand, have worked successfully together, and have achieved noteworthy results. 
He stressed that through the competent stewardship and democratic leadership of Speaker Romualdez, who had efficiently shepherded fiscal policies that pushed for high growth, economic transformation, and technological reforms, they were able to express and raise the issues and concerns of the underprivileged, marginalized, and neglected sectors of society, and translate their discussions into meaningful policies and concrete actions.
rows.title_short: Speech Of Minority Leader Libanan
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2023-05-31

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez commended his colleagues for their untiring support and collective efforts to fulfill the aspirations of the Filipino people.  He said that the House approved on Third Reading 33 out of 42 priority measures, with three already signed into law.
The Speaker lauded the Committee on Agriculture and Food for it inquiry on the surge in the price of onions and other agricultural products.  He took pride with the launching of the eCongres, a digital platform intended to facilitate knowledge and information exchange between the two Houses.
He commended the Committee on Ethics and Privileges for taking up the call for disciplinary action against Rep. Teves (A.) and thanked his colleagues for their individual and collective efforts to donate funds to victims of natural disasters and to provide financial assistance to people affected by the Mindoro oil spill and severe Tropical Storm Paeng, as well as for supporting the President on his official visit to the US.
rows.title_short: Address Of Speaker Romualdez ( F. M.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2023-05-31

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez (F.M.) emphasized the extensive deliberations and negotiations to pass the 2024 national budget in a timely manner which reflected the overarching target toward inclusivity and sustainability, in line with the Marcos administration´s Medium-Term Fiscal Framework, the 8-Point Socioeconomic Agenda, and the 2023-2028 Philippine Development Plan; and ensured the constitutional requirement of transparency and accountability, especially in the use of CIFs.  He cited the eight measures that became laws since the start of the current regular session.

ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez (F.M.) expressed his pride for and confidence in the achievements that the Body has delivered which include, among others, the approval of all the 20 priority measures of the Legislative-Executive Development Advisory Council (LEDAC) ahead of schedule, the passage on Third and final Reading of the 2024 General Appropriations Bill (GAB) in a timely and transparent manner, and the approval of 10 of the 17 measures which were identified as priority by President Marcos Jr. in his State of the Nation Address.

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez stated that the House will end another calendar year with remarkable accomplishments owing to the collective efforts and commendable dedication of the Members as they continue to produce landmark legislation designed to strengthen the country´s economy, revitalize businesses, and widen the scope of services for the Filipino people.  
Speaker Romualdez mentioned the successful passage ahead of schedule of 20 measures that were identified as priorities by the LEDAC, four of which were enacted into law.  He reported with great pride the passage of all 17 priority measures mentioned by the President in his second SONA and further emphasized the enactment of additional notable laws.

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.) 
Speaker Romualdez expressed his utmost gratitude for the Body´s prodigious performance and monumental output and enumerated the composition of legislative measures approved by the House and added that the 17 priority measures outlined by the President in his second SONA) were also approved.
He mentioned that all the LEDAC priority measures targeted for passage were approved three months ahead of schedule, and that the national budget was passed on time with enough fund allocations for each district to bring needed assistance and comfort to the citizenry. 
The Speaker demonstrated its resolve to address issues that impact the Filipinos by exercising its oversight functions and scrutinizing government operations, conducting legislative inquiries in aid of legislation, engaging its counterparts in the Executive Department in open and honest discussions, gathering reliable information, and offering immediate recommendations on pressing economic issues.
rows.title_short: Address Of Speaker Romualdez ( F. M.)

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER ROMUALDEZ (F.M.)
 Speaker Romualdez talked about and/or expressed concerns over the following matters:
a. The Body´s 100 percent target completion of the 20 LEDAC´s priority measures
b. laws that will fortify the country´s national defense and enhance international security posture
c. the historic trilateral meeting among Pres. Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., U.S. President Joe Biden, and Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida
d. strengthening defense and economic cooperation between the Philippines and the United States
e. U.S. Bill which will allocate $500 million in foreign military financing to the Philippines
f. OCTA Research survey which indicated a decrease in self-rated poverty and hunger among Filipino families
g. collective efforts to control inflation and increase household income
h. development agenda initiatives in healthcare, education, and digital infrastructure
i. secret “gentleman´s agreement” between former Pres. Duterte and Chinese President Xi Jinping regarding the West Philippine Sea
j. upholding territorial integrity and sovereignty in accordance with the Constitution and international law. 
k. implementation of the National Cybersecurity Plan and to protect sensitive information
l. fortifying the country´s cybersecurity command to ensure the safety of institutions and citizens against cyber threats. 
m. widening gap between farmgate and retail prices of rice and other basic goods to protect the interests of farmers and consumers while deterring profiteering

plenary deliberations on House Bill No. 10800 or the
2025 General Appropriations Bill (GAB), Speaker
Romualdez emphasized the importance of the measure
as the foundation upon which the nation´s governance
rests. It serves as the roadmap toward progress and
stability, the embodiment of their commitment as
legislators and as guardians of the national purse and
stewards of the people´s trust by ensuring that resources
are spent wisely, effectively, and with absolute
accountability.

rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER FERDINAND MARTIN G. ROMUALDEZ: Speaker Romualdez commended his colleagues,
the Deputy Speakers, Majority Leader Dalipe, and
Minority Leader Libanan, for their high spirits not only
for understanding the country´s goals and priorities
but for translating them into tangible and beneficial
changes and maintaining significant progress. He
said that once again, the Body demonstrated its
legislative efficiency and tireless efforts to strengthen
the Philippine economy, broaden the range of public
service, and reinforce the nation´s trust in governance,
and showed that Congress is an institution of action
and change.

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER FERDINAND MARTIN G. ROMUALDEZ: At the outset, Speaker Romualdez expressed his
pleasure in welcoming everyone united and ready to
serve the nation with renewed purpose and unbreakable
resolve. He then said that pursuant to Proclamation
No. 728 issued by President Ferdinand Romualdez
Marcos Jr. declaring November 4, 2024 as a “Day of
National Mourning,” the entire nation came together
to honor the victims of Severe Tropical Storm (STS)
Kristine. He called on his colleagues to find strength in
their unity and offer comfort and support to those who
have lost so much during the calamity and commended the Members who prioritized relief work during the
break with dedication and selfless commitment to
serving the nation.
rows.title_short: Address Of Speaker Ferdinand Martin G. Romualdez
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2024-11-04

rows.author: F061;
rows.title_full:
ADDRESS OF SPEAKER FERDINAND MARTIN G. ROMUALDEZ: Speaker Romualdez stated that he was compelled
to address not only the accusations hurled against him
but also the recent admission of Vice President Sara
Duterte of contacting an assassin to harm President
Ferdinand Romualdez Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza
Araneta-Marcos, and himself. He said that the statement
was reckless, dangerous, and unprecedented; a direct
threat to democracy, governance, and national security;
and not only a personal affront but also an attack on the
foundations of the government and the rule of law. The
Speaker pointed out that the gravity of the confession
could not be passed as mere rhetoric and demanded
accountability and answers.
rows.title_short: Address Of Speaker Ferdinand Martin G. Romualdez
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 2024-11-25
